text_block_list.text:
One evening, as we're walking<n>through the
shopping district...
H-hey, Big Brother?
H-hey, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Here... th-this is for you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I take a piece of paper from Rice<n>Shower's
trembling hands.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara told me about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's a New Year's raffle in the<n>shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The special prize is supposed to be<n>something
really incredible! So... um...
I got you a ticket. I want you to give it<n>a try.
choice_data_list: Why don't we do it together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I got you a ticket. I want you to give it<n>a try.
choice_data_list: Why don't we do it together?

text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way! If I'm involved,<n>there's no way
we'll w—
Eep!
Eep!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand-prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

We've got some takers! Step on up<n>and give it a
shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you really want to do it... together?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Praying for good luck, we grasp the<n>raffle spinner's
handle together and<n>turn...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>spinner's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! You did it, you did it!<n>Congrats, Big
Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! You did it, you did it!<n>Congrats, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but you're the one who won,<n>not me.
choice_data_list: We pulled the spinner together, didn't we?
We pulled the spinner together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, but you're the one who won,<n>not me.
choice_data_list: We pulled the spinner together, didn't we?
We pulled the spinner together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The grand-prize is just as much hers<n>as it is mine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really okay for me to take it too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm... in that case... d-does...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... we'll go to the hot<n>spring
together?
Since we both won... I'd like to go<n>with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that okay?
choice_data_list: If that's what you want, then of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well then, once we've done<n>everything we
want to do and need a<n>break, let's go!

Hehe! Well then, once we've done<n>everything we
want to do and need a<n>break, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rice Shower and I promise to<n>use the hot
spring vacation ticket<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-first-prize?! I can't believe it!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you pulling the spinner with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-first-prize?! I can't believe it!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you pulling the spinner with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I don't know about that.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right, you two! Here's your prize!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It looks delicious. My mouth<n>is already
wateri—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grrrooowl...
Agh! Not now, tummy! Everyone's<n>watching!
choice_data_list: Let's hurry back so we can eat.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, let's!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she's worked up an<n>appetite to
match the surprise and<n>happiness she got from
playing the<n>raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the delicious deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow... there are so many!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look at all these carrots!
choice_data_list: How are you going to eat all of those?

text_block_list.text: Look at all these carrots!
choice_data_list: How are you going to eat all of those?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! You're right. I don't know if my<n>tummy has
room for this many.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, let's think... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I make some sweets out of them,<n>will you have
some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I make some sweets out of them,<n>will you have
some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm gonna make a ton, then!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I enjoy some<n>homemade carrot
cookies with Rice<n>Shower.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third-prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can't believe it. I thought my<n>bad luck
would bring us absolutely<n>nothing, like always...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It may be third-prize, but a win is a<n>win. Rice Shower
keeps the carrot as<n>a memento of our day together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Of course I lost. I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Still, thanks for trying with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Of course I lost. I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: Still, thanks for trying with me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I wanted you to get a good prize...Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I quickly give Rice Shower a tissue<n>from the pack to
wipe her tears.
